full_prompt_en: A square color studio photograph shows two children seated close together against a plain off-white wall, looking straight into the camera without smiling. The boy on the left has tousled dark hair, blue-gray eyes, and a serious slightly lowered brow. He wears a black jacket over a white shirt with a narrow black tie. The girl on the right has a short dark bob with blunt loose ends and bangs, pale blue eyes, and softly closed lips. She wears a white collared blouse beneath a black jacket. Both figures are shown from about the waist upward, with their shoulders nearly touching and their torsos facing forward. Their black clothes meet in the middle as one broad dark mass, separated mainly by the white shirt fronts. A crumpled pale fabric or paper-covered surface crosses the bottom edge, partly obscuring their hands and lower bodies; its irregular folds break the severe symmetry. The wall behind them is blank, only slightly uneven in tone, with no objects or writing. Lighting is frontal and fairly even, but soft enough to leave gentle modeling around the noses, hair, and cheeks. The faces hold a natural warm skin tint and restrained freckles or small blemishes, while the background remains cool cream. The image has the direct, almost clinical clarity of a staged photographic portrait, yet fine grain and slight color softness keep it from feeling polished. Dark jacket shapes form a stable base beneath the two pale faces. Their eyes are the clearest small details and the main points of connection with the viewer. The composition is simple and balanced, using repetition of white collars and dark outer layers to give the paired sitters a quiet, unsettling formality.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形彩色影棚照片呈现两名孩子紧挨着坐在素灰白墙前，不带笑容地直视相机。左侧男孩有蓬乱黑发、蓝灰眼和略压低的严肃眉线。他穿黑外套、白衬衫，系窄黑领带。右侧女孩有短黑波波头，发尾和刘海松散而齐，浅蓝眼、嘴唇柔和闭合。她在黑外套里穿白色翻领上衣。两人从大约腰部以上入画，双肩几乎相触，躯干都朝前。黑衣在中间接成一片宽暗色块，主要由两处白色衣襟分开。一道揉皱的浅色布料或覆纸表面横过底边，部分挡住双手和下半身；不规则褶线打断严整对称。身后墙面空白，只有轻微明暗不匀，没有物件或文字。照明正面且相当均匀，却足够柔和，在鼻、头发和脸颊周围留温和塑形。脸有自然暖肤色、克制雀斑或小瑕疵，背景保持冷奶油色。照片有摆拍肖像那种直接、近乎冷静的清晰，但细颗粒和轻微色彩柔度使它不显精修。深外套形构成两张浅色脸下方的稳定基底。双眼是最清楚的小细节，也是与观者联系的主点。构图简单平衡，重复的白领与深外层让成对坐者显得安静而有点不安的正式。
style_prompt_en: Color studio photography places closely spaced, similarly scaled focal forms against an almost blank pale ground. Near-frontal soft light keeps small surface details clear without dramatic shadow, while dark outer masses merge into a broad stable base. Repeated light vertical accents separate the darker center and reinforce a nearly symmetrical composition. Color stays restrained: warm natural midtones, cool cream background, and deep near-black fabriclike areas. Fine photographic grain and slight softness prevent the clarity from becoming synthetic. The lower edge may be interrupted by irregular pale folds that loosen the formal geometry. The result is direct, quiet, and slightly tense through unadorned spacing and steady focal clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色影棚摄影把紧挨且尺度相近的焦点形放在近乎空白的浅底前。接近正面的柔光使细小表面细节清楚，没有戏剧性阴影；深色外部大块合成宽而稳定的基底。重复浅色竖向重点分开更暗的中心，并加强近对称构图。色彩克制：自然暖中间调、冷奶油背景和近黑的布料状区域。细摄影颗粒与轻微柔度避免清晰感变得人工。下边沿可由不规则浅褶打断，使正式几何松开。整体以无装饰间隔和稳定的焦点清晰度显得直接、安静而略有张力。
theme_en: Two solemn children in dark formal clothes against a plain white wall
theme_zh: 两名穿深色正装的孩子站在素白墙前，神情严肃
name: Oliviero Toscani
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
